author: Felipe Bordeu
description:
# Remesh: Refine a Tetrahedral Cube

This workflow generates a coarse tetrahedral unit cube and refines it using **MMG in-memory remeshing**. It displays the original and refined meshes side by side, previews their node-ID tables, and exports both meshes.

The remeshing settings target an edge-size range of **0.08–0.18**, with a geometric approximation tolerance (`hausd`) of **0.01**. Coloring by element ID helps reveal the surface triangulation; it does not represent mesh quality.

## Try it

1. Click **Run workflow**—no input files or demo uploads are needed.
2. Open the **3D view** to compare the coarse cube with the shifted, remeshed copy.
3. Refresh **User Files** to download `Remesh-before.xdmf` and `Remesh-after.xdmf`, together with their companion HDF5 files.

The exported meshes share the same unshifted coordinate frame; the offset is for display only.

> **Requirement:** Execution needs Muscat with the compiled **MmgInMemory** backend. Browser execution works only when its WASM build includes that backend.
